## Checklist

- [ ] I edited `data/library.yml`, not `README.md`, `exports/` or the generated pages in `docs/` (those are built from the YAML).
- [ ] The entry has authors in published order, publisher, year, and an ISBN-13 (books), a DOI (papers and reports where one exists) or a stable URL.
- [ ] The "why" is two or three plain sentences tied to illicit trade work, and "audience" is one short line.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/build.py` and committed the regenerated files, or I ticked "Allow edits by maintainers" so we can regenerate them.
